newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA'S SAA EXPANDS LINKS WITH AMERICAN AIRLINES.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA'S SAA EXPANDS LINKS WITH AMERICAN AIRLINES.

text.p: South African Airways said on Monday that it and American Airlines would expand their existing co-operative services agreement to include additional reciprocal codesharing services between Johannesburg, Cape Town and several points within the U.S.
With effect from October 1, American Airlines will place its AA designator code on SAA flights between Johannesburg, Cape Town and Miami.
On October 27 the relationship between the two airlines will expand to allow SAA to place its SA designator code on selected American Airlines services.
